description: Command list for auto-organizing solved problems from judge.cpp.
note: Commands use ';command @file-or-folder' format. The agent looks up the command in cmd.json and executes it.

commands.description: Regenerates/fixes each problem folder's README.md from solved judge.cpp problems, matching ProblemTemplate.md.
commands.modifier: Fixes md files in mentioned folder/file to match ProblemTemplate. If none mentioned, targets all problems under solve/.

commands.description: Scaffolds a new problem: folder, h/cpp files, README template, and test files.
Reviews code in a problem folder and improves solution idea/complexity/code sections to match ProblemTemplate.
commands.modifier: Reviews the file or folder mentioned by the user.
commands.output: Updates the solution idea, complexity, and code blocks in README.md.

commands.description: Lists all solved problems under solve/ in a table format.
commands.modifier: Whole list, or filter by site with ;list @<site>.
commands.output: Table: ProblemName | site | difficulty | problem number | status.
